scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir backend/app --app-dir backend --port 8000
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && node ../scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff check app tests scripts
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && node ../scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff format app tests scripts
